name: Safir Deri
description: Finely crafted leather goods, exquisitely Turkish.
story: Safir Deri, a name synonymous with luxury leather craftsmanship in Turkey for over a century, seeks to broaden its international appeal through motorsport. We believe the dedication, precision, and pursuit of excellence in racing mirrors our own commitment to quality. We aim to associate our brand with success and the thrill of competition.
